items.description: GET /api/stock/{sku} returns exactly one record per location for a SKU stocked at multiple locations, each record carrying the location and its quantity
render <App> in <MemoryRouter initialEntries={["/skus/:id"]}> with mocked API returning multiple locations and assert one row per location is visible
each location row carries its design-guide data-testid (e.g. data-testid="location-row") and is not rendered via inline style
GET /api/stock/{sku} returns the combined tracking code (inventory_code) for a stock record that carries one

render <App> in <MemoryRouter initialEntries={["/skus/:id"]}> with a mocked API response that includes inventory_code on a location record and assert the combined tracking code text is visible on that row
the tracking-code element carries its design-guide data-testid (e.g. data-testid="inventory-code") rather than an inline style
GET /api/stock/{sku} returns the par-level field as null or absent when the SKU's par level is not tracked
render <App> in <MemoryRouter initialEntries={["/skus/:id"]}> with a mocked API response where par_level is null and assert the 'not tracked' indicator is visible with no crash and no blank region
when par_level is null the indicator element carries data-testid="par-level-untracked" as its design-guide seam

render <App> in <MemoryRouter initialEntries={["/skus/:id"]}> with a mocked API response where par_level key is absent entirely and assert the 'not tracked' indicator is visible with data-testid="par-level-untracked" and no crash
